verification_summary.balance_notes: Race or-governor swept 2026-10-19 with the same issue list and stop rules for all three candidates. Smith: 3 items (all T2, one campaign page), 18 gaps. Kotek: 20 items (15 T2, 5 T3), 1 gap. Drazan: 14 items (9 T2, 4 T3, 1 T1), 10 gaps. Smith's low count reflects a one-page site and little coverage, but his gaps include 'not searched (low coverage)' for 13 issues, so effort was lighter than for the major-party candidates. Spot-search found OPB pieces on Smith (2026-07-23, 2026-09-16) and The Ballot Brief not collected.
